exposure: maternal serum albumin level during early pregnancy
cohort: 39,200 women who had a singleton live birth at a tertiary-care academic medical center between January 2017 and December 2020
finding: A higher maternal serum albumin level during early pregnancy was associated with poor fetal growth, with the detrimental effects becoming apparent as early as the mid-gestation period.
birth_weight: mid-term estimated fetal weight and at birth
